_notes: CA public hospital district, Lancaster (LA County). 420-bed acute care. Building $400M new tower. Moody's withdrew Ba2 rating prior to 2023 'for business reasons'; through window, only S&P maintained rating. NOT in default — chronic junk territory.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's withdraws Antelope Valley Healthcare District's (CA) revenue bond rating for business reasons. At time of withdrawal rating was Ba2/stable (Oct 2021 upgrade).

sp.citation_text: S&P Global affirmed AVHD at BBB and revised outlook to negative from stable on Feb 28 2023 (so prior was BBB stable).

fitch.citation_text: No public Fitch rating identified for AVHD.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Sustained weak financial performance through FY2022 and six-month interim; building $400M tower funded partly by $50M investment vehicle.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Antelope Valley Healthcare (Lancaster, Calif.) had its outlook revised to negative from stable on Feb. 28 because of sustained weak financial performance, according to S&P Global. Its default rating and that on specific bonds was affirmed at BBB.

sp.citation_text: S&P held BBB/negative through window; no further public action identified before window_end.

outcome_class_rationale: S&P revised outlook negative Feb 2023, BBB rating affirmed; no notch downgrade in window. Moody's rating withdrawn prior to window. Honest disclosure of weak financials should not trigger LIE detectors.
